description: Add the owner-facing admin leads dashboard (client-side, reads leads captured by FEAT-001 from localStorage), plus SEO/deploy infrastructure (vercel.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml) and a comprehensive README documenting setup, customization, Vercel deployment, and features deferred due to the offline/no-backend constraint. Depends on FEAT-001 (shares localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' and window.SALON_CONFIG).
steps: Create admin.html: a simple, clean, mobile-responsive owner dashboard that reuses assets/css/styles.css and loads assets/js/config.js then assets/js/admin.js. Layout: header with salon name + 'Leads Dashboard' title, a summary bar (total leads, leads today), a search/filter input (filter by name/phone/service), a table (or responsive card list on mobile) of captured leads showing name, phone (as tel: and WhatsApp click-to-chat link), service, preferred date/time, message, and created timestamp, and action buttons: 'Export CSV', 'Refresh', and 'Clear all' (with a confirm() guard). Add a short note in the UI explaining leads are stored in this browser's localStorage (device-local) and that the primary real-time delivery channel is WhatsApp.

Create assets/js/admin.js (vanilla JS, DOMContentLoaded): read the leads array from localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' (safely handle empty/invalid JSON), render newest-first into the table/card list, compute summary counts (total + today based on createdAt), implement live client-side search/filter, implement CSV export (build CSV string from leads and trigger download via a Blob + object URL, no external lib), a per-lead WhatsApp reply link built from the lead phone (wa.me), and 'Clear all' that empties the localStorage key after confirm(). Escape/handle user-provided text safely when injecting into the DOM (use textContent, not innerHTML, for lead values to avoid XSS).

Create vercel.json configuring a static deployment: no build step, cleanUrls true, trailingSlash false, and sensible security/caching headers (e.g. X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy). Ensure it is valid JSON and does not reference any build command (Vercel will serve the repo as static output).

Create SEO assets: robots.txt (allow all, reference sitemap) and sitemap.xml (list index.html; do NOT include admin.html in the sitemap and disallow /admin.html in robots.txt so the owner dashboard is not indexed). Use a placeholder production URL clearly marked for the owner to replace, and mirror any canonical/og:url placeholders used in index.html.

Write README.md: project overview; the chosen dependency-free stack and WHY (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode blocks npm installs, so the app is pure static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS — deploys instantly on Vercel with zero build); how the free lead-generation + WhatsApp click-to-chat flow works; step-by-step CUSTOMIZATION guide pointing to assets/js/config.js (salon name, WhatsApp number in international format, services, hours, address) and the placeholder production URLs in index.html/sitemap.xml/robots.txt; how to run locally (`python3 -m http.server 8000`); how to deploy to Vercel (import the GitHub repo, no build command / framework preset 'Other', output = repo root); how the owner uses admin.html to view/export leads; and a clearly-labeled 'Deferred / future phases' section explaining what was intentionally left out due to the offline/no-backend constraint (server-side lead persistence/database, automated SMS/email reminders, paid WhatsApp Business API auto-replies, multi-branch support, analytics) and how they could be added later.
Add a small favicon reference and any remaining shared assets so both index.html and admin.html have no broken references.
acceptance_criteria: `NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/admin.js` passes with no syntax errors.

admin.html loads over `python3 -m http.server` (HTTP 200) and, given leads present in localStorage under 'aplus_salon_leads', would render them newest-first with total/today counts (logic reads the same key FEAT-001 writes).

Admin renders lead text using textContent (not innerHTML) so lead field values cannot inject markup; 'Clear all' is guarded by confirm(); CSV export builds a downloadable file with no external library.
vercel.json is valid JSON, declares no build command, and enables cleanUrls; robots.txt disallows /admin.html and references sitemap.xml; admin.html is absent from sitemap.xml.
README.md documents the stack rationale, config.js customization (incl. WhatsApp number format), local run, Vercel deploy steps, and a Deferred features section.
verification: Run `NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/admin.js` and confirm exit 0.
Run `python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('vercel.json'))"` to confirm vercel.json is valid JSON, and confirm exit 0.

Start `python3 -m http.server 8000`; `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8000/admin.html` returns 200; confirm robots.txt contains 'Disallow: /admin.html' and sitemap.xml does NOT contain 'admin.html'.
Confirm every asset referenced by admin.html (css/js) exists on disk and README.md contains the Deferred features section and Vercel deploy instructions.
findings: Implemented admin.html (owner dashboard), assets/js/admin.js, vercel.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, README.md; added admin CSS + new .btn--sm/.btn--danger/.sr-only variants to shared styles.css. Reads localStorage key 'aplus_salon_leads' (same as FEAT-001/main.js), renders newest-first, computes total/today counts, live search by name/phone/service, CSV export via Blob+objectURL (UTF-8 BOM), per-lead tel: and wa.me reply links. Service ids resolved to names via window.SALON_CONFIG.services. All lead field values injected via textContent (innerHTML only used with '' to clear our own containers) to prevent XSS; Clear all guarded by confirm(). Responsive: table >=768px, card list <768px, using [hidden]+media-query display rules. vercel.json: cleanUrls true, trailingSlash false, no build command, security headers (X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy) + asset cache header. robots.txt disallows /admin.html and references sitemap; sitemap.xml lists only home page (no admin.html); placeholder domain https://a-plus-salon.example.com/ mirrors index.html. VERIFICATION: NODE_OPTIONS="" node --check assets/js/admin.js -> exit 0; python3 json.load(vercel.json) -> exit 0; local static server smoke test returned HTTP 200 for admin.html/index.html and every referenced asset (css/js/img), robots.txt, sitemap.xml. ENV NOTE: the long-running-command guard rejected even a single-invocation backgrounded 'python3 -m http.server ... & ...; kill' line, so the smoke test was run via a self-contained python3 heredoc that starts SimpleHTTPRequestHandler on a daemon thread, issues urllib requests, then shuts down.
